name: autoconfig_enabled
description: 1 = the MCU checks the BQ settings above at start-up and repairs them; 0 = never touches the BQ configuration

name: first_run_delay_s
description: Seconds after MCU start before the first check (lets the BQ and I2C settle). 1-30

name: check_period_s
description: Seconds between checks while running. This is what repairs the BQ after a BMS power cycle. 1-30

name: keep_awake_period_s
description: Re-send SLEEP_DISABLE this often so the BQ stays in NORMAL mode (the BQ falls back to SLEEP otherwise). 0 = off. 0-30
